BOOK ONE · LESSON 094

When did you/will you go to ...?

你过去/将在什么时候去……？

A lesson on past and future time expressions. A time-reference table (last week/this week/next week/the week after next, and similar for month and year) is followed by fifteen small pictures of world cities (Athens, Beijing, Berlin, Bombay, Geneva, London, Madrid, Moscow, New York, Paris, Rome, Seoul, Stockholm, Sydney, Tokyo). Students listen to questions about when people went to or will go to these cities. Written exercises A (rewrite sentences using will) and B (answer questions following the example) are transcribed from the textbook. Workbook practice covers making sentences with went/will go pairs and open-ended personal questions. Grammar exercises practise answering questions using shall/will with given cues, and changing statements into questions.

Written exercises A — Rewrite these sentences using will

Rewrite these sentences using will. 模仿例句改写以下句子，用上 will。

Example:
He went to Beijing last year.
He will go to Beijing next year.

Rewrite each sentence, changing the past time expression to a future one and using 'will'.

Written exercises B — Answer these questions

Answer these questions. 模仿例句回答以下问题。

Example:
Will you go to Athens next week? (Beijing)
No, I won't go to Athens next week. I'll go to Beijing.

Answer each question following the printed example, using the city in parentheses as the alternative destination.

I. Answer the questions, using the cues given according to the example. 仿照例句用所给的词回答下列问题。
